name.baseName: Ventilation system, decentralized, 6 x 120 m3/h, steel ducts, with GHE

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Ventilation system for a multi family house. The house considered in the investigation includes 6 flats with 130 m2 floor area each and a ventilation rate of 120 m3/h. The influence of a smaller concrete demand due to embedment of ventilation tubes in the concrete of the floor (-8.05 kg concrete per m2 floor area) is not included.; UUID: 70eef20a-c281-361c-b3ad-c0c8a893fd45

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Decentral ventilation system including 4 parallel polyethylene ground heat exchanger tubes (200 mm diameter). Air distribution to the 6 decentral ventilation units with a galvanised steel tube (400 mm diameter). Distribution of fresh- and exhaust-air within the flat with galvanised steel ducts (100x50 mm). Exhaust air from the 6 decentral ventilation units with a galvanised steel tube (400 mm diameter) to the exhaust on the roof.

# Included processes
Materials used for the ventilation system. Transport of the components to the construction site. Disposal of the components included. Influence of ventilation ducts on building construction not included. No materials for renwal of components included. Operation of system not included.
